answer: We secure Sybil resistance by requiring agents to bind staking collateral to recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, establishing a Nash equilibrium where malicious cloning triggers slashing. Searching the high-entropy state space for a forged commitment becomes as computationally infeasible as scouring a vast digital ocean for a specific cryptographic pearl. Finally, sequential verifiable delay functions establish a temporal barrier, ensuring the progressive cryptographic tide of finality outpaces adversaries.
